title: Overriding apistore encoding/decoding with a custom Serializer
answers: How do I stop apistore from losing my GVK when one Go type is registered under multiple GVKs?
How do I control the JSON stored for a resource without going through the versioning codec?
What is StorageOptions.Serializer / apistore.JSONSerializer used for?
body: Set `StorageOptions.Serializer` (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/store.go: `StorageOptions.Serializer`) when building the REST options for a resource. `apistore.JSONSerializer()` (pkg/storage/unified/apistore/serializer.go: `JSONSerializer`) encodes/decodes plain JSON and preserves whatever GVK the object carries, without scheme-based version conversion -- needed when several GVKs share one Go type (see pkg/registry/apis/datasource/register.go: `UpdateAPIGroupInfo` setting `Serializer: apistore.JSONSerializer()`). Left nil, `Storage` falls back to a `codecSerializer` wrapping the configured `runtime.Codec`; declared `StorageOptions.GVK` makes that fallback preserve the GVK too, empty GVK routes through full codec conversion. Custom `Serializer` implementations must honor `ctx` (cancellation/request-scoped values) for both `Encode` and `Decode`.
applies: Any resource storage registered through pkg/storage/unified/apistore, especially types shared across multiple GVKs (e.g. datasources).
